notes: Frames32–63; four seeds for Sponza/Cornell/glossy static, one seed for glass/foliage and motion.
8x8 block metrics target low-frequency temporal changes and variation between independent seeds; they are not accuracy measures.

Rough opaque surfaces use light-only direct sampling and sparse indirect reflection samples. Reflections have separate spatial and temporal reconstruction; final image denoising uses four passes versus three.
Motion screenshots are qualitative screening, not motion-compensated flicker measurements.
Baseline: b9eb1d2; candidate: separate direct-light passes, adaptive diffuse refresh and sparse rough reflection history.

Final performance controls explicitly disable all three new options and use three denoising iterations; candidates enable all three and use four. Controls use the new lean indirect integrator, previously measured nearly identical and performance-neutral against b9eb1d2.
shipped-perf.json is excluded: promoted defaults accidentally enabled new sampling in its control jobs. matched-perf.json replaces it.

Earlier dense and half-rate camera/light recovery prototypes were rejected because of motion frame-time regressions. Final rough reflections use a sparse grid on every frame, including motion and lighting changes.
Hardware timings drifted substantially across runs; compare paired controls rather than historical absolute times. No causal explanation for drift was established.
GPU frame timings include rendering and denoising, exclude presentation/UI/browser scheduling. Isolated pass timings are diagnostic and not additive.
Visual screening covers camera and analytic-light motion, not animated meshes. Multi-member views reject the direct-light specialization.
Build passed; 603 CPU tests passed, 7 skipped; 19 focused GPU and 10 shipped identity GPU tests passed.
